pathway.value: Modified skills assessment (being renamed 'Essential' / 'Essential Plus' later in 2026) for people currently registered with NMBA/Ahpra (or NCNZ/MCNZ)
pathway.quote: Apply for this assessment if you are currently registered as a nurse or midwife in Australia or New Zealand.

registrationRequired.quote: To qualify for a Modified skills assessment, you need current registration from one of the following: Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA/Ahpra)

qualificationEvidence.value: Graduation certificates and transcripts for all relevant qualifications (with commencement/completion dates); for a masters in nursing/midwifery, also prior qualifications
qualificationEvidence.quote: If you are submitting a masters degree in nursing or midwifery, please also provide the qualifications you completed prior to this

englishTestForAssessment.quote: If you are applying for a Modified Skills Assessment, you do not need to provide English language test results.

workExperienceForGeneralCodes.value: None required for 254499 RN NEC, 254111 Midwife, 411411 Enrolled Nurse
workExperienceForGeneralCodes.quote: If you do not have work experience, choose one of these general codes that apply to you:

workExperienceForSpecificCodes.value: At least 3 months (260 hours) paid employment within the last 5 years aligned with the nominated specialty code, supported by a professional reference letter from a nurse/midwife/clinical supervisor (not HR/payroll); without it, only 254499 RN NEC can be assessed
workExperienceForSpecificCodes.quote: You must provide at least 3 months (260 hours) paid employment within the last 5 years that aligns with your nominated ANZSCO code.

workExperienceForPoints.value: To have experience listed on the outcome letter for visa points: 12 months (1040 hours) paid Australian or 36 months (3120 hours) paid overseas experience
workExperienceForPoints.quote: 12 months (1040 hours) paid Australian work experience, or

validity.quote: confirm the validity period (2 years from the date of issue).

fee.value: AUD 395 (fees and names due to change later in 2026)

upcomingChange.value: Essential = Australian-registered, qualifications only; Essential Plus = qualifications plus work experience (for specific ANZSCO codes or points); expected later in 2026
upcomingChange.quote: This assessment only assesses your qualifications.

qualification.value: NMBA-approved, ANMAC-accredited entry-to-practice RN program (Bachelor or Masters degree), AQF Level 7 or above, delivered in Australia

clinicalPlacement.quote: a minimum of 800 hours of quality PEP

body.value: Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA) via Ahpra
body.quote: To work in Australia as a nurse or midwife, you need to be registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA).

requiredToWork.quote: Nurses and midwives must be registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia

englishStandardAppliesToAustralianGradua.quote: This registration standard applies to all nurses and midwives applying for initial registration, regardless of whether they qualified in Australia or overseas.

englishPathways.quote: The revised ELS registration standard outlines three pathways that you can use to demonstrate your English language competence:

value.sittings: One sitting, or max two sittings within 12 months subject to per-component floors

englishTestScores_testsOnOrAfter2026-04-.quote: Minimum test scores for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026.

englishTestScores_testsOnOrBefore2026-04.quote: Minimum test scores and requirements for tests taken on or before 22 April 2026.

exemptionPrimaryLanguage.value: English as primary language plus at least 6 years primary+secondary education taught and assessed in English in a recognised country (incl. 2 years in years 7-12); suits those who grew up and studied in Australia
exemptionPrimaryLanguage.quote: at least six years of primary and secondary education taught and assessed in English

exemptionExtendedEducation.value: At least 5 years (FTE) continuous education taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country, including the nursing/midwifery tertiary qualification; exceptional pathway. International students who completed only a 2-3 year Australian degree generally will not meet this and need the test pathway
exemptionExtendedEducation.quote: at least five (5) years (full-time equivalent) continuous education, in English in a recognised country, which includes tertiary qualifications in the relevant professional discipline.

recencyOfPractice.value: Minimum 450 hours practice within the past five years (for renewal/registration)
recencyOfPractice.quote: You need to provide evidence that you have practised for a period equivalent to a minimum of 450 hours, within the past five years.

keepRegistrationCurrent.quote: You also need to keep your Australian registration current.

nonGenuineClaims.quote: Non-genuine claims will result in a negative skills assessment outcome and a 2-year lock-out period for a new skills assessment.

qualification.value: NMBA-approved, ANMAC-accredited entry-to-practice midwifery program (Bachelor, Graduate Diploma or Masters), AQF Level 7+ Bachelor minimum
qualification.quote: Australian Qualifications Framework level 7 or above for the award of a Bachelor Degree as a minimum.

registrationType.value: Registration as a midwife with NMBA (not RN registration)
registrationType.quote: If you hold registration as a registered nurse, enrolled nurse or midwife in Australia

standardChange.quote: The revised Registration standard: Endorsement as a nurse practitioner will come into effect on 14 January 2027.

gaps: australianStudyRoute.nominalDuration: null - ANMAC/NMBA standards set AQF level and placement hours but no course duration; durations vary by university and were not taken from any single university page.
Midwife and EN nominal durations likewise not stated by regulator: null.

ANMAC pages do not say whether 254411 Nurse Practitioner requires NMBA NP endorsement for a positive assessment; anmacEndorsementRequirement is null. The NMBA endorsement rules are recorded, but ANMAC's own criteria for this code are not.

For 254211, 254311, 134212 and 254212, ANMAC states only the generic rule (3 months/260 hours within 5 years aligned with the code). No role-specific criteria were found, e.g. management or research duties, or whether 134212 needs a nurse-registration-based role.
Did not verify on Home Affairs that ANMAC is the assessing authority for every listed code (notably 134212); assumed per task.
ANMAC says new assessment names, fees and a new portal (Essential/Essential Plus/Comprehensive) take effect 'later this year' (2026). The $395 fee and 'Modified' name may change soon.
The RN Accreditation Standards 2019 PDF URL is on an older /assets path; ANMAC's standards page lists the 2019 standards as current.
Primary language pathway full criteria (e.g. 'recognised country' list) are in the ELS standard PDF and were not separately quoted.
